title: Prior Authorization Intake Form
subtitle: Capture service request, medical-necessity reference, payer route, and decision period; confirm denial reason and appeal.
description: Prior Authorization records service request, medical-necessity reference, payer route, decision period, denial reason, and appeal. Prior Authorization evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this prior authorization structured intake when staff must document service request and medical-necessity reference. Reconcile payer route, decision period, denial reason, and appeal before the prior authorization handoff. Use the payer form or portal record, procedure or service details, medical-necessity support, submission proof, pending-request log, approval terms, denial letter, and appeal receipt. This workflow follows the payer decision itself through portal submission, pending status, information request, approval scope, units or date limits, denial rationale, peer review, resubmission, and appeal. Record authorization number, certified quantity, approved site, validity window, case reviewer, fax or portal transaction, determination letter, reconsideration appointment, and escalation deadline. Ask the assigned prior authorization reviewer to confirm service request against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Prior Authorization starting details
sections.guidance: Track service request, medical-necessity evidence, payer portal or call reference, decision period, approval scope, denial reason, resubmission, and appeal deadline. Keep any urgent prior authorization issue with its escalation contact and time.

sections.title: Prior Authorization reported needs review
sections.guidance: Preserve the person's wording and route questions without interpretation.

blocks.label: Prior Authorization stated need or goal

fields.label: Person's words, desired outcome, and priority

blocks.label: Prior Authorization intake readiness
items: Service request is identified for this record
Medical-necessity reference matches the current request or source
Payer route is ready for point-of-use staff
Decision period limits or questions are resolved
Denial reason is communicated to the responsible person

sections.title: Prior Authorization receiving route and handoff
sections.guidance: Assign open questions and confirm where the intake goes next.

blocks.label: Prior Authorization intake receipt
blocks.guidance: Receipt confirms routing, not professional review.
